name: 语音
description: 按住 🎤 说话（豆包识别，边说边进输入框），文字进输入框；点喇叭听回复，长按输入框旁的 🔊 打开自动朗读：agent 做完就念，几个并行时排队、不重复。输入和朗读各有开关。

settings.title: 语音输入
settings.description: 📎 右边的 🎤：按住说话，松手发送，上滑取消，右滑放进输入框编辑。

settings.title: 豆包 Key
settings.description: 火山引擎控制台 → 豆包语音 → API Key（新版控制台）；老版控制台填 Access Token，并在下面填 App ID。

settings.title: 豆包 App ID
settings.description: 只有老版控制台需要：应用的 App ID。新版控制台留空。

settings.title: Azure Key
settings.description: Azure 门户里语音（Speech）资源的「密钥和终结点」页，KEY 1 或 KEY 2。朗读选 Azure 时用。

settings.title: Azure 区域
settings.description: 同一页的「位置/区域」，如 eastasia、southeastasia、eastus。

settings.title: 纠错模型
settings.description: 可选，一般不用：每说完一句就交给这个模型，结合对话改同音字和术语，改好的直接换掉那一句（填 Gerdr 设置 → 模型里配好的，如 subhub/gpt-6.1-terra）。开着时松手后要等最后一句纠完。

settings.title: 我的词表
settings.default:
Claude
Codex
agent
Gerdr
MCP
skill
prompt
session
add-on
commit
PR
settings.description: 一行一个，常说又容易认错的词：产品名、人名、术语。每次识别连同这段对话里出现过的英文词一起当提示。

settings.title: 朗读
settings.description: 消息旁的 🔊 念那一条；输入框旁的 🔊：点一下念最新回复，长按开关自动朗读。

settings.title: 朗读用
settings.description: 换了服务商，下面跟着换成它的设置。

settings.title: 音色
settings.description: 豆包语音合成 2.0 的音色，用「试听」听一下。

settings.title: 语速
settings.description: 相对正常语速快多少，0 是正常，负数变慢。

settings.title: MiMo API Key
settings.description: 在 platform.xiaomimimo.com 申请。

settings.title: 朗读风格
settings.default: 自然、亲切、利落，不要播音腔，语速中等偏快，句与句之间停顿短一点
settings.description: 一句话说想要的语气，随文字一起发给模型。清空就是模型默认的读法。

settings.title: 接口地址
settings.description: 走代理 / 中转时改这里。

settings.title: 音色

options.label: 晓晓 多语言（女声，中英混读）

settings.description: 常用的几个；别的选「自定义…」，在下面填语音名。用「试听」听一下。

settings.title: 语音名
settings.description: Azure 语音库（Voice Gallery）里的语音名，如 zh-CN-XiaohanNeural、en-GB-SoniaNeural。

settings.title: 语速
settings.description: 相对正常语速快多少，0 是正常，负数变慢。

settings.title: 读哪些
settings.description: agent 的回复：只读最后一段（干完活的总结），跳过过程中说的话；或者全读。只读最后一段时，读着读着点前面的某段，也会从那段接着读下去。你发的消息总是全读。

settings.title: 免提播报
settings.description: 长按输入框旁的 🔊 打开（只对这台设备）。几个 agent 一起做完时排队，一条接一条；每一轮只念一次。

settings.title: 也念 agent 自己醒来的那轮
settings.description: 后台任务跑完、agent 自己接着说的那轮。默认不念：这种轮次多又碎。

settings.title: 试听
settings.label: 播放
settings.description: 用上面的朗读设置念一句，听听对不对。

en.name: Voice
en.description: Hold 🎤 to talk (Doubao recognition, words go into the composer as you speak). Tap a speaker to hear a reply; hold the one by the composer for auto read: replies are read as agents finish, queued, each once. Input and reading each have a switch.

azureKey.description: KEY 1 or KEY 2 on the "Keys and Endpoint" page of your Speech resource. Used to read aloud when Azure is picked.

azureRegion.title: Azure region
azureRegion.description: The Location/Region on the same page, e.g. eastasia, eastus.

words.title: My words
words.description: One per line: words you say often that get misheard (product names, people, terms). Sent as hints with the English words from this conversation.

playMode.title: Hands-free
playMode.description: Turn it on by holding 🔊 by the composer (this device only). Agents finishing together queue up; each turn is read once.

includeAuto.title: Also read turns the agent started itself
includeAuto.description: After a background task, when the agent reports on its own. Off by default: many and small.

ttsProvider.title: Read with
ttsProvider.description: Switch it and the settings below switch to its own.

azureVoice.title: Voice
azureVoice.description: A few common ones; for any other pick "Custom…" and type its name below. Try it with Preview.

azureRate.title: Speed
azureRate.description: How much faster than normal; 0 is normal, negative is slower.

preview.title: Preview
preview.label: Play
preview.description: Reads a sentence with the reading settings above.

fixModel.title: Fix-up model
fixModel.description: Optional, rarely needed: each finished sentence goes to this model (configured in Gerdr, Settings → Models), which reads the conversation and fixes misheard words in place. With it on, letting go waits for the last sentence's fix.

doubaoKey.title: Doubao key
doubaoKey.description: Volcengine console → Doubao Speech → API Key (new console); the old console's Access Token, with the App ID below.

doubaoAppId.title: Doubao App ID
doubaoAppId.description: Only for the old console: the app's App ID. Empty for the new console.

enableInput.title: Voice input
enableInput.description: The 🎤 right after 📎: hold to talk, let go to send, slide up to cancel, right to edit it in the composer first.

enableOutput.title: Read aloud
enableOutput.description: The speaker beside a message reads it; the one by the composer: tap to read the latest reply, hold to turn auto read on / off.

mimoStyle.title: Style
mimoStyle.description: The tone you want, in a sentence, sent to the model with the text. Empty: the model's own reading.

mimoBaseURL.title: API address
mimoBaseURL.description: Change it to go through a proxy.

scope.title: What to read
scope.description: For an agent's reply: only its last part (the summary once the work is done), skipping what it said along the way; or all of it. Reading the last part, a tap on an earlier paragraph still jumps there and reads on. Your own messages are always read whole.

doubaoVoice.title: Voice
doubaoVoice.description: A Doubao TTS 2.0 voice; try it with Preview.

doubaoRate.title: Speed
doubaoRate.description: How much faster than normal: 0 is normal, negative is slower.

azureVoiceName.title: Voice name
azureVoiceName.description: A voice name from Azure's Voice Gallery, e.g. zh-CN-XiaohanNeural, en-GB-SoniaNeural.
